Question / decision needed: How is the kg ↔ sheet formula provided?
Options considered: (a) a CEL computed field only; (b) package code that writes an item-specific UOM conversion; (c) both
Recommendation: (c): a read-only computed field shows sheet weight (g); package code sets '1 kg = n sheet' (n = 1e9 / (GSM × L × W), 10 places) as the item's own conversion, so stock and costing use the normal UOM engine
Final decision: Done as recommended
Validation still needed: Confirm with a pilot that conversion by nominal GSM is acceptable (actual GSM varies ±5%; reel register by weight remains the truth)

Question / decision needed: How are masters imported from Excel without a second set of validation rules?
Options considered: (a) separate import validator; (b) run the normal service per row inside a savepoint, roll back on dry run
Recommendation: (b): exceljs behind one adapter file; template columns from package fields; dry run = savepoint per row then rollback; commit only when every row is valid (all or nothing); 2 MB / 5,000 rows
Final decision: Done as recommended
Validation still needed: Pilot: does Tally's party export map cleanly to the template?
